title: A dorm style with a community bath/shower
content: This is a strange one and it's definitely a repeating theme although not same people in the dream. The actual set up and location changes but it's that same "theme". But very real feeling and I always wake up from these feeling so emotionally attached to the other people. Feels so so real or at least more "important". Anyone else? I'd say I've had this same theme dream at least 5 times this year.
